# Webflow: The Visual Website Experience Platform

> Webflow empowers modern businesses, marketers, and developers to design, build, and optimize high-performing websites in a visual environment that unites design freedom, AI-assisted workflows, and enterprise-grade scalability. With a composable CMS, advanced localization, and integrated optimization tools, teams deliver exceptional digital experiences faster—without sacrificing performance, brand control, or governance.

---
## Core Platform Capabilities

### Build
- [Platform Overview](https://webflow.com/platform): Discover the power of the Webflow platform.
- [Design](https://webflow.com/feature/design): Complete visual control of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- [Edit Mode](https://webflow.com/feature/edit-mode): Marketer-friendly editing for real-time content updates.
- [Interactions & Animations](https://webflow.com/feature/interactions-animations): Motion design tools powered by GSAP.
- [Page Building](https://webflow.com/feature/page-building): Rapid creation of responsive landing pages.
- [Shared Libraries](https://webflow.com/feature/shared-libraries): Centralized, reusable components for design systems.
- [Collaboration](https://webflow.com/feature/collaboration): Real-time co-editing, roles, and workflow management.
- [AI Site Builder](https://webflow.com/ai-site-builder): Launch complete sites faster using generative AI.

### Manage
- [CMS](https://webflow.com/feature/cms): Visual, composable content management for structured data.
- [Hosting](https://webflow.com/feature/hosting): Global CDN, enterprise reliability, and automated scaling.
- [Localization](https://webflow.com/feature/localization): Multi-language management with translation workflows.
- [AI Assistant](https://webflow.com/feature/ai): Generate page sections, copy, and layouts within brand context.
- [Security](https://webflow.com/security): SOC 2 Type II, GDPR compliance, SSO, and advanced roles.

### Optimize
- [SEO](https://webflow.com/feature/seo): Semantic markup, meta controls, and structured data.
- [Analyze](https://webflow.com/feature/analyze): Native analytics for performance and engagement insights.
- [Optimize](https://webflow.com/feature/optimize): AI-powered testing and personalization to lift conversions.

### Extend
- [Apps Marketplace](https://webflow.com/apps): Extend Webflow with integrations like HubSpot, Adobe Express, and Figma.
- [Integrations](https://webflow.com/integrations): Connect to marketing, CRM, and analytics platforms.
- [Webflow Cloud](https://webflow.com/feature/cloud): Deploy full-stack apps using frameworks like Next.js or Astro.
- [DevLink](https://webflow.com/feature/devlink): Sync visual components directly to codebases.
- [Figma to Webflow](https://webflow.com/feature/figma-to-webflow): Import Figma designs for production-ready websites.

## Compare Platforms
- [Webflow vs Contentful](https://webflow.com/vs/contentful): Unified visual CMS and frontend vs headless-only approach.
- [Webflow vs Framer](https://webflow.com/vs/framer): Enterprise scalability and CMS vs lightweight prototyping.
- [Webflow vs WordPress](https://webflow.com/vs/wordpress): Visual control and security without plugin overhead.
- [Webflow vs Squarespace](https://webflow.com/vs/squarespace): Custom interactions and layouts beyond fixed templates.
- [Webflow vs Wix](https://webflow.com/vs/wix): Semantic code output and developer extensibility.
- [Webflow vs Shopify](https://webflow.com/vs/shopify): Fully customizable ecommerce experiences.
- [Webflow vs Vercel](https://webflow.com/vs/vercel): Webflow unifies design systems, code standards, CMS, and AI-powered personalization and localization — all within one secure, governed platform.
- [Webflow vs Sitecore](https://webflow.com/vs/sitecore): A visual development platform that connects everyone in the web development process.
